About the Fest
More Than a Fest — It's a
Movement
Aethera is the upcoming annual national-level technical, cultural, and sports festival organized by the student fraternity at Kakatiya University College of Engineering and Technology, Warangal. It stands at the forefront of fostering innovation, creativity, and competitive excellence among young engineering minds across Telangana.
Recognized as one of the largest fests in Telangana, the event has grown exponentially — attracting participants from diverse engineering institutions and providing a dynamic platform to showcase brilliance across disciplines.
Host Institution
KU College of Engineering and Technology, Kakatiya University Campus, Hanamkonda

Kakatiya University Campus, Warangal, Telangana
17 – 19 April 2026

What to Expect

Highlights
Day 1 — 17 April 2026
Inauguration & Technical Events
Grand opening ceremony followed by paper presentations, coding challenges, and discipline-specific workshops across all engineering branches.
Day 2 — 18 April 2026
Robotics, Workshops & Cultural Kickoff
Robotics competitions and immersive workshops in the morning; cultural competitions including dance, music, and talent showcases in the evening.
Day 3 — 19 April 2026
Sports Finals & Prize Distribution
Grand finals for all sports tournaments, prize distribution ceremony, and a spectacular DJ night to close Aethera in style.
